title: Pure source-only lighting declarations over complete original document-text-v3

native.limits: Whole consumer input: existing portable native JSON 8000000 serialized UTF8 bytes incl punctuation/escaping,200000 nodes with keys,depth64,container32768,string2000000 codepoints; pages512/records100000 as existing v3. No separate per-record budget multiplied by claims. Descriptor-first/no custom callbacks before guard; fail on proxy/getter/cycle/hole/surrogate/float/unsafe/nonfinite.
native.textArtifactHash: Existing document_text_v3_content_hash: SHA256(portableCanonical({hashDomain:"document-text-v3-content-v1",artifact:FULL_ENVELOPE})). Preserve all pages, profiles, native/unlocated records.
native.declarationContentHash: SHA256(portableCanonical({hashDomain:"matrix-zu130-lighting-technology-v3-source-id-v1",declaration:FULL_DECLARATION})). Hash helper validates exact bounded declaration DTO first; content identity is not authentication.
native.canonical: Existing codepoint-key sorted portable scalar canonical JSON; no Unicode/number normalization.

lexicalPolicy.rule: Preserve rawText unchanged. If last codepoint is LF remove exactly that one from grammar view; then remove only U0020 SPACE at beginning/end of that view. Record resulting half-open Unicode CODEPOINT usedTextRange {start,end} on every fragment. Empty view or any remaining CR/LF/TAB rejects grammar. Never str.trim/strip/NFKC/casefold. Optional absent terminal LF accepted.
lexicalPolicy.reason: Actual original v3 F0161 first line has leading/trailing ASCII SPACE plus LF; second trailing SPACE plus LF. Frozen v2 had already stripped these. This explicit NEW lexical policy avoids hidden producer normalization.
lexicalPolicy.approval: ROOT accepted before implementation under existing user authorization. Record codepoint offsets, preserve full raw; no old grammar changes.

grammar.group: Same anchored two-line source wording as frozen v1: Светотехническое +оборудование +приняты +с +энергосберегающими +источниками +света ; then (<TECH>), на базе продукции компании «<MANUFACTURER>». Exact punctuation and aliases; manufacturer cannot contain U0022/U0027/«/»/parentheses/controls. No manufacturer/model/energy-saving inference. Group remains UNBOUND_GROUP_DECLARATION.
grammar.noAliases: No lowercase Latin, typographic punctuation repair, alternatives, negation, substring, model decoding or technology ranking.

sourceAndGeometry.native: Copy exact located nativeBoxPointStrings and integer bbox; no float reparsing/rounding in consumer. Native frame from original selected page, no PDF Rotate/visibility claim.
sourceAndGeometry.unlocated: Exact selection of unlocated original line => SELECTED_TEXT_UNLOCATED. Any other unlocated record on selected page => UNLOCATED_PAGE_TEXT, conservative first version even if geometrically remote. No fake bbox/region relevance heuristic. Unlocated on other valid pages stays intact in full source hash and does not veto selected candidate page.
sourceAndGeometry.quality: After selected-page unlocated veto require TEXT_LAYER_CANDIDATE; OCR_REQUIRED => SOURCE_TEXT_UNAVAILABLE. This certifies only producer quality disposition.
sourceAndGeometry.geometry: Use exact numeric sourcePath parents and the explicit groupGeometry rules in this canonical artifact; no v2 block/line aliases.
sourceAndGeometry.interleavers: Any nonempty other located whole line touching/intersecting derived union => AMBIGUOUS_LAYOUT; fixed v3 whitespace criterion. No cropped text, nearest-line joins or glyph splicing.
sourceAndGeometry.visibility: Always renderedVisibility:"UNVERIFIED". Native Form text can be clipped/occluded despite located line. Neither source nor PDF text reader proves rendering/physical existence/completeness.

gateOrder: 2 FULL v3 semantic validation and content hash
3 original source ID/SHA match and actual pageStages range
6 exact original path/raw association; absent or altered => SELECTION_MISMATCH
7 selected unlocated => SELECTED_TEXT_UNLOCATED; otherwise selected-page unlocated veto; selected quality
8 located union/group geometry and full selected-page interleavers
9 explicit lexical view + exact literal grammar
x-semantic-contract.compatibility: NEW pure consumer only. Accept all three explicitly recorded canonical document-text-v3 traversal policies after whole artifact validation; never v2 facade or native path migration. Keep old v1 lighting modules/goldens unchanged. No runtime/DB/release/machine/coverage/UI integration in this packet.
x-semantic-contract.inputIdentity: SourceFileId follows frozen lighting clean Unicode scalar key policy1..200; exact source/artifact ID and SHA. Stage map has canonical positive safe decimal keys1..16digits within actual pageCount; every non-UNRESOLVED override must equal top-level stage; no stage inference.
x-semantic-contract.association: Selection fragment has ONLY original sourcePath and exact rawText. Resolve both located and unlocated arrays by original path before geometry. Duplicates invalid; requested raw or path mismatch SELECTION_MISMATCH. A selected unlocated record wins SELECTED_TEXT_UNLOCATED, then any other selected-page unlocated vetoes UNLOCATED_PAGE_TEXT, then require TEXT_LAYER_CANDIDATE. No other-page unlocated veto; full artifact still hashed.
x-semantic-contract.limits: Native guard applies once to whole input before any artifact property lookup/callback; same portable limits as complete v3 including200000nodes/depth64/container32768/string2000000/codepoint JSON8MUTF8 including punctuation/escapes. INPUT_LIMIT wins over malformed later structure. Whole reader INPUT_LIMIT propagates; other reader failures INVALID_TEXT_ARTIFACT. No input truncation.
x-semantic-contract.ordering: Located selections must be in visual order: top edge descending, left edge ascending, then numeric lexicographic original path (shorter prefix first). Order failure INVALID_SELECTION. Selected unlocated is resolved before visual ordering. Interleavers use fixed v3 whitespace codepoint set, not host Unicode categories. All touching/intersecting nonempty other located whole lines in selected region cause AMBIGUOUS_LAYOUT.
x-semantic-contract.groupGeometry: Two fragments only; heights9000..14000mpt inclusive, difference<=1000, absleftdelta<=16000, first right>=second right, vertical gap firstbottom-secondtop in0..18000 inclusive. If original source paths have exactly same parent path, second final child index must equal first+1; otherwise no fake parent adjacency. Region is exact bbox union. Same selected page only.
x-semantic-contract.hashHelper: The declaration hash validates bounded exact declaration DTO shape, safe integer dimensions/boxes, native decimal strings/frame shape, flags/null, path cardinality/uniqueness, raw scalar/range shape, literal enums and scope/cardinality/position relation before canonical hashing. It cannot authenticate textArtifactHash/profile/physical identity without the full original source. Do not synthesize a v3 artifact as validation facade. Reconstructed declarations already have whole source validation; rawTechnology/technology/position/usedTextRange must remain exact parser output.
